kv06.text: The economy of Kestrel Valley depended on copper smelting from 1880 until the last furnace closed in 1964. The closure cost roughly 2,300 jobs. In response the council, led by Mayor Brannoch Pell, created the Kestrel Textile Cooperative in 1967, which today employs about 900 people.

kv06.title: kestrel_valley_history.pdf p.1

kv06.title: kestrel_valley_history.pdf p.1

kv06.title: kestrel_valley_history.pdf p.1
